body:
#: 15
Decision: Body language for needs and moods
Notes: Needs: play (brings a toy, bounces), rest (yawns, lies down), attention (follows close, looks up, nudges), food (sniffs, sits by the empty bowl). Moods: very very happy, happy, normal, sad. Each pet type shows them its own way

comments.text: 31 Oct: needs are now two. Food signs = hungry; all other signs = unhappy.
31 Oct: one need now (happiness). All signs, food ones too, mean unhappy.

title: Pet decision 15: Body language for needs and moods
